The render shows none of it; it jumps straight from 'The order of reactivity of halides with amines is RI > RBr >RCl.' to '3. Reduction of nitriles'.

findings.what: The three equation images (R-NH3X + NaOH, the nitrile reduction and the amide reduction) are set two to three times the surrounding type size, far larger than the book sets them, and each sits in an added ruled frame the book does not draw. The first scheme RNH2 -> R2NH -> R3N -> R4NX, by contrast, is set smaller than the book and its '(1 deg)/(2 deg)/(3 deg)' labels are pulled up onto the same line as the formulae.

note: Compared the RNH2/R2NH/R3N/R4NX series, the free-amine equation, the two ammonolysis paragraphs, the reactivity-order line, the Example 9.1 box, and methods 3 and 4 with their equations.
